Name: Yuki Takahashi

Work Experience:
- 2023--2023: Economics Research Intern, Mitsui Institute for Economic Studies. Assisted senior economists in data collection and statistical analysis related to Japanese labor market trends. Conducted literature reviews on recent developments in behavioral economics and presented findings during weekly seminars. Supported the preparation of economic models by cleaning and organizing large datasets using R and Excel. Collaborated with a team to draft preliminary reports on fiscal policy impacts, contributing insights from independent research. Participated in policy briefings and gained hands-on experience with econometric tools used in industry-standard research.

Education:
- 2021--2023: M.A. in Economics, University of Tokyo. Main courses: Advanced Microeconomics, Econometrics, Development Economics, Labor Economics, Policy Analysis
- 2017--2021:
